english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Three Images that are in the righteous Person
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter is almost entirely oldest teaching substrate. After a single-line dialogue frame opening (¶1), the remaining nine paragraphs form a cohesive three-degree anthropological teaching: corporeal → psychic → spiritual images, with a process description of how the living soul ascends through these degrees by divesting itself of what does not belong to it. The teaching is systematic, impersonal, and process-oriented. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system — no editorial bridges, no contemporary application, no institutional content, no exhortation. The light virgin, the new man, the Light Mind, and the three images are all cosmic entities/structures. The negative editorial fatigue score (-2.99) confirms that the later-layer vocabulary is concentrated only in the opening frame, with the rest being clean substrate. One of the purest teaching chapters in the corpus.
